versions.changelog:
- Added a Security & Trust section explaining registry use and safe CLI execution practices
- Expanded documentation on registry resolution order and how to override the default
- Updated CLI usage instructions to prefer global install, with fallback to npx if not available
- Minor clarification and reformatting throughout for improved guidance and readability

Initial release of rush-reskill-usage — a usage guide for the reskill package manager.

- Introduces CLI-based workflows for installing, managing, and publishing AI agent skills.
- Documents supported commands, options, install formats (GitHub/GitLab, registry, HTTP/OSS, etc.), and multi-agent setup.
- Provides quick start instructions, troubleshooting guidance, and project setup help.
- Details requirements and compatibility (Node.js >= 18.0.0).
- Explains monorepo and subpath support, along with installation from archive or custom registry URLs
